a11y.accessibleName: The nav landmark label, 'Pagination' by default.

keyboard.Tab: Moves through the page links in order.

notes: Real links, so pagination works with no JavaScript and pages are shareable and bookmarkable.
Each number carries a visually hidden 'Page' prefix, so it announces as 'Page 2' rather than '2'.
Previous and Next are omitted at the ends rather than rendered disabled.

whenToUse: A result set split across pages.
whenNotToUse: Fewer results than one page holds.
